inputs.prompt:
Reference inputs
<Picture 1>: Background and initial pose reference
<Picture 2>: Character appearance and final pose reference
<Audio 1>: Absolute source of dialogue, timing, pronunciation, and lip synchronization

5-second video, single continuous shot.

Preserve the bedroom background, furniture, lighting, camera angle, and composition of <Picture 1> throughout the entire video. Use <Picture 2> as the exact reference for the character's appearance, hairstyle, elf ears, translucent purple wings, clothing, facial expression, hand gestures, and final pose.

0–1 seconds:
Begin with the original rear-facing composition of <Picture 1>. The character speaks according to the actual audio in <Audio 1>. Keep movements subtle and natural.

1–3 seconds:
The character smoothly turns around from the rear-facing pose toward the front-facing pose shown in <Picture 2>. The torso, shoulders, head, hair, and wings move continuously and naturally. Keep the camera stationary and the background unchanged. If speech occurs during the turn, synchronize the mouth to <Audio 1>.

3–5 seconds:
The character finishes turning and approaches the pose and framing of <Picture 2>. Reproduce the shy expression, blush, eye direction, and hand gestures. Synchronize every mouth movement with the actual Japanese pronunciation and timing in <Audio 1>.

The Japanese dialogue description is only a semantic hint. The actual audio overrides any estimated transcript. Do not invent, paraphrase, extend, or replace dialogue.

Maintain consistent character identity, body proportions, clothing, and illustration style. No cuts, no camera transitions, no background changes, no flickering, no identity drift, and no unnatural body movements.

// Audio preservation
Use the original <Audio 1> as the final audio track. Discard any audio generated by the model and replace it with the original audio during
